Database ERD

erDiagram
    Author {
        str created_at
        str updated_at
        int id PK
        str name
        str email
        str bio "nullable, default None"
        bool is_active "default True"
    }
    Post {
        str created_at
        str updated_at
        int id PK
        int author_id FK
        str title
        PostStatus status "default DRAFT"
        str summary "nullable, default None"
    }
    Tag {
        int id PK
        str label
    }
    PostTagLink {
        int post_id PK,FK
        int tag_id PK,FK
    }
    PostStatus {
        enum DRAFT
        enum PUBLISHED
        enum ARCHIVED
    }
    Post }o--|| Author : "author_id"
    Post ||--o{ PostTagLink : "post_id"
    PostTagLink }o--|| Tag : "tag_id"
